summary: Redesigned the session tree UI by consolidating label, branch, and 'here' badges under a single `tree-meta` element in SessionTreeList.svelte, then updated the matching mobile CSS selectors in session-tree.css. Verified the changes with prettier formatting, svelte-check (0 errors/0 warnings), the full vitest suite (42 files, 210 tests passing), and git diff --check.
decisions: Consolidated tree-entry badges (label, branch, here) into one `data-ui='tree-meta'` flex container rather than separate grid columns, so mobile layout can wrap and align them as a group.
errors: pnpm check:hooks reported 3 pre-existing dead data-ui hooks (`native-folder-picker`, `window-control`, `window-controls`) styled in CSS but unused in markup; root `pnpm check` remains blocked by these unrelated issues.
